MR. JUSTICE PARTHIVJYOTI SAIKIA  O R D E R 19.06.2023 Heard Mr. D. Talukdar, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. D.
Das, the Addl. Public Prosecutor representing the State of Assam.
This is an application under Section 438 of the CrPC in respect of Page No.# 2/2 Haflong P.S. Case No.16/2023 registered under Section 120(B)/420/406/468/471 of the Indian Penal Code.
The informant Anil Kumar K. wanted to have a civil work order of Rs.35 crores from NCHAC Dima Haso.
One person called Narendranath Sinha befriended with him and told to deposit Rs.2.5 crores for getting the said work order.

Accordingly, the informant deposited Rs.2.5 crores in the bank Pronit Gogoi vs The State Of Assam on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93402444/
1 accounts of six persons and after that, Narendranath Sinha handed over to him the supply order.

sentences.text: After receiving the supply order, the informant started to supply different goods, like- blankets and mosquito nets etc.

But even after supplying of those goods, the informant never received any payment and thereafter on query, it came to light that the work order given to him (the informant Anil Kumar K.) by Narendranath Sinha, was a false one.
However, the petitioner's name is not available in the FIR.
The case diary reveals that the present petitioner and some other persons are also involved in the entire operation.
Therefore, at this stage, the prayer for bail as preferred by the petitioner is not found to be satisfactory and stands rejected.
The application for bail is disposed of Return the case diary.
